model_search: Start with SiT-XL/2. Consider RF++ ImageNet-64 only if SiT loading, compute or recognizability fails. Cap each checkpoint transfer at 160 seconds and limit SiT sampling discovery to the two recipes below.

pilot.selection: Use midpoint unless clear class or quality failures appear on its pilot outputs; otherwise use the official dopri5 recipe.

qualification.rule: Score every unfiltered animal draw. Wrong class, ambiguity, or malformed subjects count as failures. A clearly recognizable cat or dog of any breed satisfies the class test. Use a frozen classifier as an independent corroboration after validating it on source-labeled and corrupted reference images.

adaptation_feasibility.trainable_layers: attention qkv and output, MLP input and output in the last 12 blocks
